knownTaskObservation: GET retry with backoff on the SAME task ID; never create again merely because polling timed out
missingCreateResponse: mark submission-uncertain; retain full reserved estimate and stop dependent paid steps; reconcile provider task history/account state, never automatically retry POST
beforeCreate: Bind approved four-view image bytes; record SHA256 and pixel dimensions.
Pin endpoint, model, all request parameters and request SHA256.
Obtain explicit user authorization for selected provider, exact operations and total credit ceiling.
Recheck primary production pricing and balance; do not treat wallet balance as a spending limit.
Atomically persist submitting intent and reserve operation estimate in a durable ledger before sending exactly one POST.
afterCreate: Persist task ID before any subsequent network action.
Poll same task until authoritative terminal state; download bytes to a fresh path.
Record actual consumed credits and reconcile account balance/frozen credits.
Stop next paid step if cost exceeds the approved per-operation or total estimate.

hardCap.documentationFinding: No per-task maximum-spend field or pre-task quote endpoint is documented in the inspected generation, rigging, billing, balance and task-query references. Do not claim that absence proves no private feature exists.
hardCap.enforcement: Local fixed operation count and conservative reservation only. This is NOT a provider-enforced hard monetary cap.
hardCap.strictProviderGuaranteedCapRequired: Do not submit until a provider-confirmed account/key budget or price quote is available.

secrets: Credentials only from existing environment; never serialize headers, API keys, tokens or signed result URLs to review artifacts.
